title: Starry Fusion - One Tab
description: A large silhouetted figure made of flowing letters and lava-like streams dominates a surreal night landscape, with a small fiery writer at a desk inside its chest. In the background, a giant full moon contains a tiny hooded figure, while paper boats sail on waters flowing over cliffs under a starry sky filled with floating text.
prompt: Surreal night landscape featuring a giant silhouetted hooded figure composed of colorful floating letters and glowing orange lava flowing from its form. Inside the figure's chest area, a small fiery demonic writer sits at a desk typing. A massive full moon in the starry sky contains a tiny hooded figure within it. Paper boats with text on their sails float on purple waters cascading over cliffs. Distant mountains and constellations with faint handwritten text complete the dreamlike scene.
